SELECT 
  (SELECT AVG(c.Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth c 
   JOIN customers t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE c.Date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' 
     AND t.Currency = 'CZK' 
     AND t.Segment = 'SME') - 
  (SELECT AVG(c.Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth c 
   JOIN customers t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE c.Date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' 
     AND t.Currency = 'CZK' 
     AND t.Segment = 'LAM') AS SMEvsLAM,

  (SELECT AVG(c.Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth c 
   JOIN customers t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE c.Date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' 
     AND t.Currency = 'CZK' 
     AND t.Segment = 'LAM') - 
  (SELECT AVG(c.Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth c 
   JOIN customers t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE c.Date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' 
     AND t.Currency = 'CZK' 
     AND t.Segment = 'KAM') AS LAMvsKAM,

  (SELECT AVG(c.Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth c 
   JOIN customers t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE c.Date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' 
     AND t.Currency = 'CZK' 
     AND t.Segment = 'KAM') - 
  (SELECT AVG(c.Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth c 
   JOIN customers t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE c.Date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2013-12-31' 
     AND t.Currency = 'CZK' 
     AND t.Segment = 'SME') AS KAMvsSME

SELECT 
  (SELECT AVG(c.Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth c 
   JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE c.Date LIKE '2013%' AND c.CustomerID IN 
     (SELECT CustomerID 
      FROM transactions_1k 
      JOIN customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID 
      JOIN yearmonth ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID 
      WHERE transactions_1k.Amount < 1000 AND customers.Currency = 'CZK' 
      GROUP BY CustomerID 
      ORDER BY SUM(Consumption) 
      LIMIT 1)), 
  (SELECT AVG(c.Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth c 
   JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE c.Date LIKE '2013%' AND c.CustomerID IN 
     (SELECT CustomerID 
      FROM transactions_1k 
      JOIN customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID 
      JOIN yearmonth ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID 
      WHERE transactions_1k.Amount < 1000 AND customers.Currency = 'CZK' 
      AND customers.Segment = 'LAM' 
      GROUP BY CustomerID 
      ORDER BY SUM(Consumption) 
      LIMIT 1)), 
  (SELECT AVG(c.Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth c 
   JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE c.Date LIKE '2013%' AND c.CustomerID IN 
     (SELECT CustomerID 
      FROM transactions_1k 
      JOIN customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID 
      JOIN yearmonth ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID 
      WHERE transactions_1k.Amount < 1000 AND customers.Currency = 'CZK' 
      AND customers.Segment = 'KAM' 
      GROUP BY CustomerID 
      ORDER BY SUM(Consumption) 
      LIMIT 1)), 
  (SELECT AVG(c.Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth c 
   JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE c.Date LIKE '2013%' AND c.CustomerID IN 
     (SELECT CustomerID 
      FROM transactions_1k 
      JOIN customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID 
      JOIN yearmonth ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID 
      WHERE transactions_1k.Amount < 1000 AND customers.Currency = 'CZK' 
      AND customers.Segment = 'SME' 
      GROUP BY CustomerID 
      ORDER BY SUM(Consumption) 
      LIMIT 1))

SELECT (AVG(CASE WHEN t1.Segment = 'SME' THEN t3.Consumption ELSE NULL END) - AVG(CASE WHEN t1.Segment = 'LAM' THEN t3.Consumption ELSE NULL END)) AS LAMvsSME,
       (AVG(CASE WHEN t1.Segment = 'LAM' THEN t3.Consumption ELSE NULL END) - AVG(CASE WHEN t1.Segment = 'KAM' THEN t3.Consumption ELSE NULL END)) AS LAMvsKAM,
       (AVG(CASE WHEN t1.Segment = 'KAM' THEN t3.Consumption ELSE NULL END) - AVG(CASE WHEN t1.Segment = 'SME' THEN t3.Consumption ELSE NULL END)) AS KAMvsSME
FROM customers t1
JOIN transactions_1k t2 ON t1.CustomerID = t2.CustomerID
JOIN yearmonth t3 ON t1.CustomerID = t3.CustomerID AND YEAR(t3.Date) = 2013
JOIN gasstations t4 ON t2.GasStationID = t4.GasStationID
WHERE t4.Country = 'Czech Republic' AND t1.Currency = 'CZK'

SELECT 
  (SELECT AVG(Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth ym 
   JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID 
   JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE ym.Date >= '2013-01-01' AND ym.Date < '2014-01-01' 
   AND c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'LAM') - 
  (SELECT AVG(Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth ym 
   JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID 
   WHERE ym.Date >= '2013-01-01' AND ym.Date < '2014-01-01' 
   AND c.Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM, 

  (SELECT AVG(Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth ym 
   JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID 
   JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE ym.Date >= '2013-01-01' AND ym.Date < '2014-01-01' 
   AND c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'KAM') - 
  (SELECT AVG(Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth ym 
   JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID 
   WHERE ym.Date >= '2013-01-01' AND ym.Date < '2014-01-01' 
   AND c.Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME, 

  (SELECT AVG(Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth ym 
   JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID 
   JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID 
   WHERE ym.Date >= '2013-01-01' AND ym.Date < '2014-01-01' 
   AND c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'SME') - 
  (SELECT AVG(Consumption) 
   FROM yearmonth ym 
   JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID 
   WHERE ym.Date >= '2013-01-01' AND ym.Date < '2014-01-01' 
   AND c.Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM
